suggestions.title: The Big Lebowski
suggestions.description: A laid-back Los Angeles slacker known as 'The Dude' gets caught up in a convoluted kidnapping plot. The Coen Brothers' cult classic turns mistaken identity and a stolen rug into cinema's most endlessly quotable shaggy-dog story. Jeff Bridges' sublime chilled-out performance anchors a surreal, hilarious, and surprisingly warm comedy about a man who just wants to bowl.

suggestions.title: Downfall
suggestions.description: The final ten days of Adolf Hitler's life inside his Berlin bunker as the Third Reich crumbles. Bruno Ganz gives one of cinema's most haunting portrayals of Hitler in this claustrophobic historical drama, told largely through the eyes of his secretary Traudl Junge. A gripping, morally complex examination of the final collapse of Nazi Germany.

suggestions.title: La La Land
suggestions.description: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in modern-day Los Angeles. Damien Chazelle's dazzling, Oscar-winning musical gave Hollywood back its sense of wonder — a swooning, bittersweet love letter to Los Angeles, jazz, and the people who dare to dream. Emma Stone and Ryan Gosling have never been more magnetic together.
